edges.relationship: Megtron-class thin-core laminate and prepreg for Isu Petasys high-multilayer AI/switch boards

contracts.signal: Isu Petasys half-year report (filed 08-14-2026) names Panasonic as a supplier of THIN CORE (copper-clad laminate, the base material for circuit formation): thin-core purchases were KRW 126,205M in H1 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30), 47.61% of total raw/sub-material purchases of KRW 265,088M, shared among Panasonic, EMC (Elite Material) and Doosan Electronics with no per-supplier split disclosed. Thin-core unit price rose to USD 61.29/m2 imported (vs USD 56.16 for FY2025) and USD 52.52/m2 domestic (vs 48.34), driven by the higher share of high-end material and raw-material price increases.
